name: Payment Means 1
definition: Means by which a payment will be or has been made for settlement purposes.

PaymentType.name: Payment Type
PaymentType.definition: Type, or nature, of the payment, eg, express payment.

PaymentMethodCode.name: Payment Method Code
PaymentMethodCode.definition: Transfer method to be used for the transfer.

PayeeCreditorAccount.name: Payee Creditor Account
PayeeCreditorAccount.definition: Creditor financial account of the payee party for this payment means.

PayeeFinancialInstitution.name: Payee Financial Institution
PayeeFinancialInstitution.definition: Creditor financial institution of the payee party specified for this payment means.

PayerDebtorAccount.name: Payer Debtor Account
PayerDebtorAccount.definition: Debtor financial account of the payer party for this payment means.

PayerFinancialInstitution.name: Payer Financial Institution
PayerFinancialInstitution.definition: Debtor financial institution of the payer party specified for this payment means.
